Spine-Link — Animation Portfolio Platform with Google Login and Upload

Spine-Link is a platform where users register or sign in with Google, upload Spine animation work, save it in an account-backed profile database, edit portfolio cards, and publish public animation portfolio links.

World SPINE ARCHIVE — Public Spine Animation Archive

World SPINE ARCHIVE is the public archive of user Spine animation works. Anyone can add their own Spine animation anonymously with the Create preview button on the archive page, or sign in with Google to create a profile. A profile can be a public portfolio with likes, views, showcase and archive publishing, or a private library that is private by default and cannot be found through the site or Google unlike public portfolios.
